{{Current events|year=2026|month=02|day=21|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] launch long-range [[FP-5 Flamingo]] [[cruise missile]]s, striking the [[Votkinsk Machine Building Plant]] in [[Votkinsk]], [[Udmurtia]], Russia. Another missile strikes a [[natural-gas processing]] plant in [[Samara Oblast]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/02/21/ukraine-strikes-long-range-missile-factory-russia/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-strikes-key-industrial-site-in-russia-ukraine-gains/a-76072701 (DW)]
**[[Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Ground Forces|Russian forces]] capture the village of [[Karpivka, Lyman urban hromada, Kramatorsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Karpivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], as they attempt to advance towards [[Lyman, Ukraine|Lyman]]. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/law-order/3812823-tensions-escalate-key-developments-in-ukraine-and-russia-conflict?amp (Devdiscourse)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]], [[2026 Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan]]
***[[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistan]] conducts intelligence-based strikes on seven locations along the [[Durand Line]] in the [[Nangarhar Province|Nangarhar]] and [[Paktika Province|Paktika province]]s of [[Afghanistan]] targeting alleged camps of the [[Pakistani Taliban]] and an affiliate of the [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]], resulting in dozens of fatalities and injuries. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/pakistan-afghanistan-clashes-pak-strikes-terrorist-camps-along-afghan-border-killing-dozens-11119592 (NDTV)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/pakistan-strikes-militant-camps-in-afghan-border-region-govt (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
**Two [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and five militants are killed in a [[shootout]] in [[Bannu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/two-soldiers-five-militants-killed-bannu-pakistan-army-says-2026-02-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Jonglei clashes (2025–present)|Jonglei clashes]]
**Up to 22 people are killed, including women and children, and several others are injured when [[Johnson Olony|Agwelek Forces]] gunmen open fire on villagers in [[Ayod County]], [[Jonglei State]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/south-sudan-villagers-killed-after-being-lured-from-homes-with-promise-of-aid-witnesses-say (CTV News)]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**The [[Islamic State]] claims responsibility for two attacks on security personnel in northern and eastern [[Syria]], in which a soldier and a civilian were killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/islamic-state-claims-two-attacks-syrian-army-announces-new-phase-operations-2026-02-21 (Reuters)]
*[[Crime in Ukraine#Terrorism|Terrorism in Ukraine]]
**A policewoman is killed and at least 15 others are injured, including some seriously, in two explosions at a shop in [[Lviv]], Ukraine. The attacks are being treated as [[terrorism]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/78476603e98b (TRT World)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[76th Berlin International Film Festival]]
**At this year's [[Berlin International Film Festival|Berlin Film Festival]], [[İlker Çatak]]'s ''[[Yellow Letters]]'' wins the [[Golden Bear]]. [https://www.philstar.com/movies/2026/02/22/2509674/political-drama-yellow-letters-wins-berlins-golden-bear (AFP via ''The Philippine Star'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] raises the global [[tariff]] on [[List of imports of the United States|imports]] from 10% to 15% under [[Powers of the president of the United States#Emergency powers|emergency powers]] that permit the measure for up to 150 days after the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]] ruled yesterday that [[International Emergency Economic Powers Act|a 1977 law]] does not authorize the imposition of [[Liberation Day tariffs|his earlier country-specific tariffs]]. [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|The administration]] states that the new rate applies broadly, with exemptions for certain sectors and goods covered by existing [[trade agreement]]s. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260221-trump-hikes-us-global-tariff-rate-to-15 (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025–26 Australian bushfire season]]
**The [[Victoria State Emergency Service|state emergency service]] of [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], issues the highest-level [[Standard Emergency Warning Signal|emergency evacuation warning]] for areas surrounding the [[A1 Mine Settlement]] of [[Gaffneys Creek]], as an uncontrolled [[bushfire]] burns the settlement. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/residents-australias-victoria-state-urged-evacuate-bushfire-rages-2026-02-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Libyan crisis]]
**At least five bodies of [[Libyan refugees|refugees]] wash ashore near [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]]. Residents also observe a child's body carried back to [[Mediterranean Sea|sea]] by strong waves, prompting a [[Libyan Coast Guard|coast guard]] search operation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/5-bodies-migrants-washed-ashore-east-libyas-capital-tripoli-police-officer-says-2026-02-21/ (Reuters)]
*Six people are killed, including a five-year-old, and three others are injured when a boat [[Capsizing|capsizes]] and sinks on the [[Grande River (Rio de Janeiro)|Grande River]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260223/d6562f4a386b4dffa088fdd1ad372acd/c.html (Xinhua)]
*The death toll from the truck explosion on a highway in [[Santiago]], [[Chile]], on Thursday, rises to six, with 15 others still hospitalized with serious injuries. [https://english.news.cn/20260222/7a0c1e849230417d985e96c69b16b83d/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people are killed in a fire at an apartment building in [[Blagoveshchensk]], [[Amur Oblast]], Russia. [https://en.iz.ru/en/2047036/2026-02-21/five-people-died-fire-apartment-building-blagoveshchensk (''Izvestia'')]
*Four children and an elderly woman are killed in a house fire in [[Voskresensk, Moscow Oblast|Voskresensk]], [[Moscow Oblast]], Russia. [https://en.iz.ru/en/node/2047112 (''Izvestia'')]
